note: The golden v2-on-v1 leaf. Both harnesses write this shape into the v1 results tree and every consumer reads it. Computed in codictate and copied verbatim to dictation-product-benchmark/tests/fixtures/v2-on-v1-leaf.json. Assert against it; do not regenerate it. The field name for the pooled v2 speed summary is speedV2 - a summary written as `speed` is invisible to charts.py, which then falls back to meanRTF and plots a differently-defined, unfiltered RTF (observed at up to 28x the contract value on external rows).

rules.sampleRange: Absent on a leaf pooling more than one run: one range cannot describe several.
rules.failuresByStatus: When present, timeout + failed === failures. failures is the total INCLUDING timeouts.
rules.legacyUnfiltered: meanRTF, totalWallSec and totalAudioSec keep their v1 meaning: session wall clock over audio, over ALL scored samples, NOT filtered by speedCompatible. All provenance-filtered v2 speed lives only under speedV2.
rules.noFallback: A missing speedV2.wallRtf means 'no publishable v2 speed'. No consumer may fall back to meanRTF; they are different definitions.
rules.poolableSums: speedV2.responseMs and speedV2.audioDurationSec are the FILTERED numerator and denominator behind responseMsPerAudioSec, and are required. A consumer pooling several leaves sums these two and divides once; averaging responseMsPerAudioSec or wallRtf across leaves is a mean of means. A leaf lacking them may only display its own per-condition wallRtf, must not contribute to a cross-condition pooled figure, and must be counted and captioned rather than weighted by something else. Note responseMs/audioDurationSec (12000 ms over 80 s, the 6 poolable Samples) differ from totalWallSec/totalAudioSec (18.5 s over 100 s, all 10 scored Samples) on purpose.
